items.acceptance: Persistent local paper-only deployment, restart, backup and restore evidence in LONGRUN_ACCEPTANCE_CN.md.

Actual Nov13 and Nov17 BaoStock receipts each have 5224 supported symbols. Nov16 follow-up login timed out; scheduled job reports failure, retaining successes. Multi-date completeness and stable availability remain open.

Real Nov13/17 unadjusted EOD status for one watched symbol per date, raw hashes and retrieval times retained. Not full-market ST coverage, exchange certification, intraday authority or next-day approval.
Same-day band suggestions, explicit per-row human batch review, no automatic approval; source conflicts/corruption block.

Account-specific preferences drive manual or explicitly installed daily research. Supported evidence scope AI/robotics/new energy; saving preferences alone never submits research or enables trading. Semiconductors/custom/hot-event discovery not implemented.

Nov17 managed observations cover the afternoon; earlier trial receipts are separate. Nov18 morning and afternoon had 1290 and 1247 usable batches, 1 and 37 stale batches, and maximum usable-receipt gaps of 16.123 and 19.564 seconds. The archive estimates fresh-batch availability at 99.6% and 49.5%, respectively. The natural Nov18 report reconciled. More observation days and reliable intraday quality are pending.
Exchange-quality intraday suspension/ST/listing/relisting/corporate-action status and complete daily bands need a validated source; unknown remains human-reviewed.

Real current receipts: BK0800 人工智能 Nov17 (758 provider / 730 supported / 28 excluded), BK1090 机器人概念 Nov18 (840 / 796 / 44), BK0493 新能源 Nov18 (220 / 215 / 5). Raw pages and DB members verified, readable in the archive browser. Nightly collection implemented separately; first natural evening execution, historical coverage and account preference mapping remain pending; see THEMES_ACCEPTANCE_CN.md.

CNinfo retains original JSON/PDF records. The Nov18 13:00 natural schedule produced 8 verified excerpts. The excerpt-aware worker and UI passed a real-evidence replay and deployed locally at 15:03. A scheduled real model result using an excerpt and broader industry news remain open.

User configured deepseek-flash; Manual and scheduled real requests completed with one evidence-scoped issuer research candidate each. The first 08:30 scheduled run completed on Nov18 using 1833 provider tokens, with verified input/output hashes and no execution authority. No executable strategy, approval or orders; title evidence only.

Evidence-linked research and human-controlled buy-once strategies are deployed locally. A paper draft can bind an exact completed candidate through the research run ID and both hashes. An isolated real backup verified authenticated draft creation. Nov18 rollout preserved the archive and left the production strategy list empty. Actual user approval, automated proposal generation and evaluation remain open.

The worker supports one simulated buy per immutable version after explicit human approval and activation. Draft creation, approval and activation precheck the fee-inclusive cap. Submission rechecks the exact hash, reserve, available cash, fresh accepted quote and current human-reviewed rules. Revocation cancels the unfilled remainder atomically. Actual user activation and a naturally triggered order remain pending.
VectorBT/Backtrader/Optuna research with point-in-time universe, cost assumptions, holdout evaluation and human strategy promotion.
Weekly out-of-sample evaluation and human-approved weight changes; Feishu interactive approval separate from webhook.
Evaluate PR358/Laya API, license, isolation and provider-specific held-out Chinese A-share calibration; not required for paper simulation.
Ubuntu local tests do not establish Windows or GitHub CI execution; workflow credentials currently insufficient.

Webhook is configured. The durable receipt release deployed locally on Nov18 at 16:12. Both existing reports retain their original content with no observed receipt. Future natural webhook acceptance and actual group display remain open.
Calendar verified coverage currently ends 2026-12-31; matching must remain closed outside known coverage.
No live broker connection and no automatic AI strategy promotion; not a deliverable to unlock.
Actual official settings/save returned success, private persistent runtime.env mode0600 / parent0700 nonroot UID10001, restart retained setting; no real API key/model request needed for test.

Official A-share search and identity metadata retained. Fixed common watchlist context labels hiding existing names; paper selectors and holdings show observed names or explicit missing-name labels; 37 frontend tests passed.

Newly generated daily reports format actual ledger, positions, fees and reconciliation. No fabricated mark-to-market returns, selection or strategy changes. Delivery is best-effort, no retry on unknown result.

Human-authenticated read-only theme list/detail APIs and official paper-page archive panel with provenance, missing-data state, bounded pagination and stale-request guards. No ingestion, order, preference or approval writes; see THEME_WEB_ACCEPTANCE_CN.md.

Daily 20:10 Asia/Shanghai fixed three-theme job with verified archive and no same-window repeats. A network-disabled SIGKILL rehearsal verified exact container cleanup, read-only recovery of the original board, and refusal when the journal is missing. First natural provider run and full host disaster recovery remain open; see THEMES_ACCEPTANCE_CN.md.
